en.summary: Compiled by Sharif al-Radi, this sermon exemplifies Imam Ali’s (AS) rhetorical mastery in linking asceticism (zuhd) not merely as material renunciation, but as a spiritual discipline to cultivate God-consciousness (khawf). The emphasis on preparing for the hereafter reflects the Shia theological view of the transient nature of worldly life (dunya) as a testing ground for eternal success. This passage serves as a practical guide for believers to balance worldly duties with spiritual readiness, a core tenet of Ali’s governance and personal conduct.

key_terms.خَوْفِ اللَّهِ: Fear of God, a spiritual state of reverence and awe
key_terms.الآخِرَةِ: The Hereafter, the eternal life after death
key_terms.مَوَاعِظ: Exhortations or sermons containing moral advice

Die Betonung der Vorbereitung auf das Jenseits spiegelt die schiitische theologische Sichtweise wider, dass die vergängliche Natur des weltlichen Lebens (Dunya) als Prüfungsstätte für den ewigen Erfolg betrachtet wird.
